sentences.en: The fucking imbecile was complaining about wind turbines destroying the scenery.
sentences.zh: 这个蠢货在抱怨风力涡轮机破坏了风景。

sentences.en: If one of the turbines is broken, there's a backup one.
sentences.zh: 如果一个涡轮机坏了，备用的那个可以顶上。

sentences.en: Tens of wind turbines have recently been built.
sentences.zh: 最近建起了几十个风力涡轮机。

senses.zh: [动力] 涡轮；[动力] 涡轮机
